description: Custom ECL queries for Prostate Specific Antigen (PSA), SNOMED component 102687007. Used for prostate cancer tracking — total PSA, free PSA, and PSA ratio observables.
_loinc_survey_doc: LOINC-side recall survey (Loinc.csv of the pinned LOINC release): regexes on COMPONENT / PROPERTY / SYSTEM that select the LOINC terms a laboratory physician would count as this analyte (CLASSTYPE 1, not DEPRECATED). The generator reports how many of them the LOINC Ontology pool reaches.
